name: com.1network/directory-readonly
title: 1Network local business directory (read-only)
description: Read-only: search US local businesses, read a page, counts and prices. Free, no key.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the 1network directory of US local businesses by category, place, rating, open now and "accepts requests". Free. Returns at most 25 businesses a page with their public phone and website, labelled sponsored or featured when paid. Use accepts_requests true to find the businesses that request_quotes can reach.

category.description: Category slug or name from list_categories, for example "plumbers".

lat.description: Latitude, with lng and radius_miles to search around a point.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around lat/lng or the ZIP code.

min_rating.description: Only businesses rated at least this many stars.

accepts_requests.description: true: only businesses that accept quote requests from AI assistants (the ones request_quotes can reach).

directory.description: Limit to one industry directory's categories. One of: auto, childcare, cleaning, dentists, electricians, fitness, hvac, lawn, lawyers, med-spa, pets, plumbers, remodelers, restoration, salons, senior-care, tax-finance, therapists, weddings, wellness.

limit.description: How many results (1 to 25, default 10; 10 a page without an API key).

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Read one business page: address, hours, services, service area, rating, claimed and verified status, whether it accepts requests from AI assistants and how quickly it usually replies. Free. Optionally includes the latest reviews.

business.description: Business id or slug, as shown by search_businesses.

include_reviews.description: Also read the latest reviews (default false).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List business categories with their slugs, optionally only those matching `search` (for example "plumb") or under one `parent`. Use the slug in search_businesses, count_businesses and request_quotes. Free.

search.description: Only categories whose name contains this text, for example "plumb".

parent.description: Only the sub-categories of this parent category slug.

limit.description: How many categories (default 25; at most 25 are shown in the text).

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List US states with business counts, or the cities of one state (pass `state`, optionally `search` to narrow by name). Free.

state.description: 2-letter state code: list the cities of this state. Leave out to list the states.

search.description: Only cities whose name contains this text.

tools.name: count_businesses
tools.description: Count the businesses 1network lists for a category, state and city (or one industry directory). Free and fast. Also tells you where to buy a list of them: lists are sold by Data Candy, never on 1network.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: What is free on 1network (searching, reading pages, quote requests and messages to opted-in businesses) and what business owners pay for: Featured, Verified badge, Category sponsor and prepaid credits. Free.
